name: 10027-longprompt-r1w4afp8-tp8
model: Barrrrry/DeepSeek-R1-W4AFP8 -- MoE expert weights int4, everything else FP8; 376.6 GB of safetensors over 82 files, 47.1 GB per card at TP8.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism OFF), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM, 61 layers, MLA (kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64), hidden 7168, 128 attention heads, 256 routed experts + 1 shared, top-8 over 8 groups, vocab 129280, YaRN to 163840 positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 240 requests with a 1200 s safety cap. 240 requests is 60 rounds of 4, leaving ~180 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets: prompts centred on 10240 tokens (stdev 2048, clamped 6144-14336) and generations centred on 512 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 256-768), seed 42. Radix cache is off, so nothing is reused and every request is a real prefill.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant serving four concurrent users with 10,000-token prompts and short answers on eight GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. The reader takes the file line by line and
# SKIPS indented lines, so re-flowing a value into a block mapping drops the key silently and the
# engine starts without it -- keep `cuda-graph-bs` on one line.

model-path: Barrrrry/DeepSeek-R1-W4AFP8
tp-size: 8
context-length: 32768
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
max-running-requests: 256
random-seed: 42
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: -1
cuda-graph-max-bs: 256
cuda-graph-bs: [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]
